verse.verse_5: Verily, that which you are promised is surely true.
verse.verse_6: And verily, Ad-Din is sure to occur.
verse.verse_7: By the heaven full of Hubuk,
verse.verse_9: Turned aside therefrom is he who is turned aside.
verse.verse_11: Who are under a cover of Sahun,
verse.verse_12: They ask: "When will be the Day of Ad-Din"
verse.verse_13: (It will be) a Day when they will be Yuftanun in the Fire!
verse.verse_14: "Taste you your trial! This is what you used to ask to be hastened!"
verse.verse_15: Verily, those who have Taqwa will be in the midst of Gardens and Springs,
verse.verse_16: Taking joy in the things which their Lord has given them. Verily, they were before this doers of good.
verse.verse_17: They used to sleep but little by night.
verse.verse_18: And in the hours before dawn, they were asking for forgiveness.
verse.verse_19: And in their wealth there was the right of the Sa'il and the Mahrum.
verse.verse_20: And on the earth are signs for those who have faith with certainty.
verse.verse_21: And also in yourselves. Will you not then see
verse.verse_22: And in the heaven is your provision, and that which you are promised.
verse.verse_23: Then by the Lord of the heaven and the earth, it is the truth, just as you can speak.
verse.verse_24: Has the story reached you, of the honored guests of Ibrahim
verse.verse_25: When they came in to him and said: "Salaman!" He answered: "Salamun" and said: "You are a people unknown to me."
verse.verse_26: Then he turned to his household, and brought out a roasted calf.
verse.verse_27: And placed it before them (saying): "Will you not eat"
verse.verse_28: Then he conceived fear of them (when they ate not). They said: "Fear not." And they gave him glad tidings of a son having knowledge.
verse.verse_29: Then his wife came forward with a loud voice; she smote her face, and said: "A barren old woman!"
verse.verse_30: They said: "Even so says your Lord. Verily, He is the All-Wise, the All-Knower."
verse.verse_31: (Ibrahim) said: "Then for what purpose you have come, O messengers"
verse.verse_32: They said: "We have been sent to a people who are criminals."
verse.verse_33: "To send down upon them stones of clay."
verse.verse_35: So We brought out from therein the believers.
verse.verse_36: But We found not there any household of the Muslims except one.
verse.verse_37: And We have left there a sign for those who fear the painful torment.
verse.verse_38: And in Musa, when We sent him to Fir`awn with a manifest authority.
verse.verse_39: But (he) turned away along with his hosts, and said: "A sorcerer or a madman."
verse.verse_40: So We took him and his armies, and dumped them into the sea (Yamm), for he was blameworthy.
verse.verse_41: And in `Ad when We sent against them the barren wind;
verse.verse_42: It spared nothing that it reached, but blew it into broken spreads of rotten ruins.
verse.verse_43: And in Thamud, when they were told: "Enjoy yourselves for a while!"
verse.verse_44: But they insolently defied the command of their Lord, so the Sa`iqah overtook them while they were looking.
verse.verse_45: Then they were unable to rise up, nor could they help themselves.
verse.verse_46: (So were) the people of Nuh before them. Verily, they were a people who were rebellious.
verse.verse_47: With Hands We constructed the heaven. Verily, We are able to expand the vastness of space thereof.
verse.verse_48: And We have made the earth a Firash; how excellent spreader (thereof) are We!
verse.verse_49: And of everything We have created pairs, that you may remember.
verse.verse_50: So, flee to Allah. Verily, I am a plain warner to you from Him.
verse.verse_51: And set not up any other god along with Allah. Verily, I am a plain warner to you from Him.
verse.verse_52: Likewise, no Messenger came to those before them but they said: "A sorcerer or a madman!"
verse.verse_53: Have they transmitted this saying to these Nay, they are themselves a people transgressing beyond bounds!
verse.verse_54: So turn away from them, you are not blameworthy.
verse.verse_55: And remind, for verily, the reminding profits the believers.
verse.verse_56: And I created not the Jinn and mankind except that they should worship Me.
verse.verse_57: I seek not any provision from them nor do I ask that they should feed Me.
verse.verse_58: Verily, Allah is the All-Provider, Owner of power, the Most Strong.
verse.verse_59: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is a portion of torment like to the evil portion of torment (which came for) their likes (of old); so let them not ask Me to hasten on!
verse.verse_60: Then woe to those who disbelieve from their Day which they have been promised.
